title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End
synopsis:
The adventure is over but life goes on for an elf mage just beginning to learn what living is all about. Elf mage Frieren and her courageous fellow adventurers have defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the land. But Frieren will long outlive the rest of her former party. How will she come to understand what life means to the people around her? Decades after their victory, the funeral of one her friends confronts Frieren with her own near immortality. Frieren sets out to fulfill the last wishes of her comrades and finds herself beginning a new adventure…

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Frieren the Slayer

episodes.title: A Real Hero
episodes.synopsis: Deep in the mountains of the northern lands, Frieren and her party arrive at the Village of the Sword, where they have another job to do. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Take Care
episodes.synopsis: Now that Sein finally has a lead on the whereabouts of his long-lost friend, is it time for him and Frieren's party to part ways? (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.synopsis: Frieren and party finally arrive in Äußerst, ready to undergo the first-class mage exam, and meet a number of colorful characters who are there to do the same. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Well-Laid Plans
episodes.synopsis: Frieren and her new teammates hatch a plan to capture a Stille - but are the other teams just going to stand by and let it happen? (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Necessary Killing
episodes.synopsis: The first-class mage exam intensifies as fighting breaks out between the participants - and what's at stake might even be worth killing for. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The World of Magic

episodes.title: Perfect Replicas
episodes.synopsis: Due to the Spiegel, a legendary monster that can create perfect replicas of others, the test-takers who would conquer the Ruins of the King's Tomb must first face the ultimate enemy: themselves. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: A Fatal Vulnerability
episodes.synopsis: A perfect imitation of Frieren stands between the test-takers and victory, but Fern believes she knows how to win. Is it time for the student to surpass the master? (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Height of Magic
episodes.synopsis: While the other Mages defend themselves against the remaining clones, Fern experiences the heights of Frieren's power as they battle the copycat Frieren. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: An Era of Humans
episodes.synopsis: With the second test behind them, only one remains - but first, Frieren and Fern need to settle an important matter in town. What awaits them in the third test? (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: It Would Be Embarrassing When We Met Again
episodes.synopsis: As the first-class mage exam concludes and the test-takers go their separate ways, farewell leads to departure - but the next stage of Frieren's journey has only just begun. (Source: Crunchyroll)
